description: This file defines event classes related to person state changes in an Orleans-based application, including PersonRegistered, PersonMarried, and PersonLastNameChanged, all implementing the IPersonEvent marker interface.

classes.name: PersonRegistered
classes.description: Represents the event when a person is registered with first name, last name, and gender.

classes.name: PersonMarried
classes.description: Represents the event when a person gets married, including spouse details.

classes.name: PersonLastNameChanged
classes.description: Represents the event when a person's last name changes.

methods.name: PersonRegistered
methods.description: Constructor initializing first name, last name, and gender.

methods.name: PersonMarried
methods.description: Constructor initializing spouse ID and names.

methods.name: PersonLastNameChanged
methods.description: Constructor initializing the new last name.
